headline: Tabled the Branch Library Manager eligibility list and took no action on Public Works internal hiring lists.
summary: Public comment covered a Public Works employee's move to the Tree Crew position and Fire Chief Shelly Carter's plan to post the Deputy Fire Marshal recruitment internally first. The commission approved the 10.06.2026 minutes, tabled the 9.25.2026 special meeting minutes, and took no action on internal hiring for four Public Works jobs. It also tabled certification of the Branch Library Manager list.
decisions: Approved the 10.06.2026 regular meeting minutes, unanimously.
Tabled the 9.25.2026 special meeting minutes until the next meeting, unanimously.
Took no action on internal applications for four Public Works positions, so Public Works could keep filling them internally; passed unanimously.
Took no action on certification of eligibility lists 26-20 through 26-24, so Public Works could keep filling positions internally; passed unanimously.
Tabled certification of list #26-24, Branch Library Manager, until the next regular meeting, unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Special Meeting 
 
11:00 AM, October 8, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 11:00 a.m. 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward, Andrea Lobo 
Staff in attendance: Ken Kelley, Lee Palmer, Alexa Panayotakis, Administrative Assistant, 
J. Susy Diaz-Callands. 
Fire Chief Shelly Carter, Nicholas Savalli.  
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. Review and approval of the CSC regular meeting minutes from 10.06.2026.  
  
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve the 10.06.2026 regular meeting 
minutes. 
• Commissioner War seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
  2. Review and approval of the CSC Special Meeting amended Minutes from 9.25.2026 
— which was tabled at the 10.06.2026 CSC Regular Meeting.   
  
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to table the 9.25.2026 special meeting minutes 
for our next meeting. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 
• Nicholas Savalli, a Public Works employee, spoke regarding his movement to the 
Tree Crew position, which was being considered for a vote.
• Fire Chief Shelly Carter addressed the request to remove the recommendation to 
post the recruitment for Deputy Fire Marshal in the Firefighters' App. She explained 
that her intention was to follow proper protocol by posting the position internally 
before proceeding with external recruitment.  
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
  
 
• None. 
 
6. ACTION ITEMS 
  
 
 
 1. Review and approve the following internal applications:  
• HEO Back Up Operator 
• Truck Driver  
• Night Custodian 
• Maintainer I - Tree Crew 
 
       
  The Commission discussed Public Work's internal process for filling vacancies under 
the collective bargaining agreement.  
• Commissioner Andrews' moved that the commission take no action on item 6-
1, allowing Public Works to continue filling the positions through its internal 
process. 
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
  
 2. Certification of the following eligibility lists:  
• List # 26-20 HEO Back Up Operator 
• List # 26-21 Truck Diver 
• List # 26-22 Night Custodian 
• List # 26-23 Maintainer I - Tree Crew 
• List # 26-24 Branch Library Manager 
 
       
  
• Commissioner Andrews' moved that the commission take no action on item 6-
2, allowing Public Works to continue filling the positions through its internal 
process. 
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to table the certification of list #26-24 
Branch Library Manager until our next regular meeting. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously  
 
 
  
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
 
  1. Discussion of scoring keys and other examination data used to administer an 
examination for employment.   
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to go into executive session at 11:17 a.m.  
Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously.  
 
Executive session was held.  
 
Commissioner Lobo motioned to come out of Executive Session.  
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 
 
8. REPORTS 
  
 None.  
9. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 None. 
10. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 None. 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 Commissioner Lobo motioned to adjourn. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passed unanimously; the meeting adjourned at 11:42 a.m.
